rationaleAppend: isaiah-woh wave I-3: territorial 'land' at Isa 8:8 ('the breadth of your land') and 8:23 ('the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali'); 'earth' at Isa 8:22 under the cosmic context clause, where ʾereṣ is the level below opposed to lᵉmāʿᵉlāh 'upward' in 8:21 (ASV, KJV, JPS 1917 'the earth'; NJPS 'look below'), the same vertical contrast as 'in heaven above and on the earth beneath' (Deut 4:39).
note: 8:22 extends the cosmic clause to an explicit above/below contrast without šāmayim; 8:8 and 8:23 are default territorial uses.
Isa 8:18 haššōḵēn bᵉhar ṣiyyôn 'who dwells on Mount Zion', YHWH as subject; 'dwell' as the entry prescribes. No canon reception note at this site.

Recorded, not applied: sealed-book-dan-12-4-9-revelation-jubilees-cross-corpus at ISA-8:16 (its wohChoice is Daniel-scoped; its source field and rationale already cross-reference Isa 8:16, which is enough for audit); elohim-imkha-divine-presence-formula at ISA-8:8 and 8:10 (the Isaiah overlay renders ʾēl 'God' and the name/clause is governed by sign-names-isaiah-7-8); elohim-as-translation at ISA-8:19, 8:21 (Genesis-scoped 'the Elohim' convention; Isaiah uses elohim-el-eloah-monotheistic-formula-isaiah); nichesh-laban-divination at ISA-8:19 (nḥš divination, a different practice); onen-soothsayer-cross-corpus (wave I-1, pending) at ISA-8:19 (different term).
